rdf:Description.dc:title: Lincoln Memorial Commission Report
rdf:Description.dc:description: In 1911 Congress appropriated funds and established a subcommittee within the Commission of Fine Arts to write a proposal for a memorial to President Abraham Lincoln. The committee undertook a national design competition for monument proposals. Their report, seen here, selected a design by architect Henry Bacon to create the Lincoln Memorial towards the end of the Mall in Potomac Park.
